title: Ethics bills on nepotism, lobbyists and ex-employees
summary: Bill 55 would let the Board of Ethics pursue violations for up to six years after a worker leaves county service, after the board lost cases when employees left. A nepotism bill, Bill 99, was deferred. Ethics staff said Maui has no countywide anti-nepotism rule and is the only county without comprehensive lobbyist rules, and a fraud risk report also noted the missing nepotism policy.

timeline.text: A committee will hear the board's priorities on July 28, 2026, including its nepotism law and lobbyist rules.
